tagline: Pre-spend trust for AI agents that buy: check x402 services and product listings before paying.
summary: Pre-spend trust for AI agents that buy. Check an x402 service (seller + resource) or a store product listing before paying: free checks, a published listing card you can verify, and approval flags when a price can't be backed. Never authorizes spend.

lanes.title: x402 services
lanes.you_are: an agent about to pay an x402 seller
lanes.free: Readiness card (allow, warn or block), wash flags, seller reputation, offline receipt check.
lanes.paid: $0.001 signed payment decision (`twzrd.payment_decision.v1`); optional $0.05 trust receipt, a signed V7 receipt when you pay on Solana.

lanes.title: Product listings
lanes.you_are: an agent about to buy a product from a store
lanes.free: `check_listing(product_url, declared_unit_price)` against a published listing card, and the Agent Shopping Check report.
lanes.paid: Optional $0.001 checkout brief for a buyer-approved Shop Pay checkout.

pieces.name: Hosted checks
pieces.alone: Free checks with nothing to install: is this x402 seller safe to pay, and does this store listing match a published card.
pieces.plugged_in: The pieces below that screen a payment call it; it is where the decisions and the signed receipts come from. The receipt verifier needs no server.

pieces.name: [`twzrd-x402-gate`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/twzrd-x402-gate)
pieces.alone: Wraps an x402 client's pay path: asks the hosted checks about the seller before your signer runs, refuses a block (the signer is never invoked), and enforces a spend cap.
pieces.plugged_in: Decisions come from the hosted checks; pairs with `x402-solana` or `@x402/fetch` as the payer.

pieces.name: [`twzrd-preflight`](https://github.com/twzrd-sol/twzrd-preflight)
pieces.alone: OpenClaw plugin: install it and every HTTP 402 is checked before a signer can attach payment (enforce and fail-closed by default).
pieces.plugged_in: Runs the same checks as the gate, against the hosted checks.

pieces.name: [`twzrd-receipt-verifier`](https://github.com/twzrd-sol/twzrd-receipt-verifier)
pieces.alone: Verifies a TWZRD receipt offline against a published Ed25519 key: no wallet, no API key, no trust in TWZRD's server.
pieces.plugged_in: Checks the signed receipts that the hosted checks issue.

pieces.name: [`twzrd-mcp-server`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/twzrd-mcp-server) / [`twzrd-mcp`](https://pypi.org/project/twzrd-mcp/)
pieces.alone: A local MCP client with 6 tools that pays the $0.001 and $0.05 calls itself under a spend cap (a wallet only if you enable paid calls).
pieces.plugged_in: Calls the hosted checks; use the hosted MCP directly for the free checks.

pieces.name: [`@wzrd_sol/plugin-trustgate`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wzrd_sol/plugin-trustgate), [`@wzrd_sol/eliza-plugin`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wzrd_sol/eliza-plugin)
pieces.alone: Framework seats: a settle hook for facilitators (see [docs](https://github.com/twzrd-sol/twzrd-trust/blob/main/docs/facilitator-trust-in-3-lines.md)), a Faremeter payer chooser, and elizaOS actions.
pieces.plugged_in: Each seat calls the hosted checks from inside its framework.

pieces.name: [`twzrd-agent-intel`](https://pypi.org/project/twzrd-agent-intel/)
pieces.alone: The server package behind the hosted checks. Run it yourself behind a firewall; a local run serves a small static snapshot, not live data.
pieces.plugged_in: Point a self-hosted instance at live data with its environment variables.

pieces.name: Seller starters: [`x402-solana-starter`](https://github.com/twzrd-sol/x402-solana-starter), [`x402-seller-starter`](https://github.com/twzrd-sol/x402-seller-starter)
pieces.alone: Cloudflare Worker templates for selling a paid API to agents over x402: `x402-solana-starter` is the production-style Solana storefront (x402 v2), `x402-seller-starter` a minimal wedge.
pieces.plugged_in: Both default to the TWZRD facilitator. `x402-solana-starter` also runs a settle guard, advisory and fail-open, that screens payers through the hosted checks.

recipes.title: Refuse before signing
recipes.result: A blocked seller never reaches your signer. Prove it with no wallet and no spend: `curl -fsS https://intel.twzrd.xyz/v1/intel/demo-gate`.

recipes.title: Keep proof of what you paid for
recipes.result: A signed receipt you or anyone else can verify offline.

recipes.title: Check a listing before you buy
recipes.result: A price above the card is refused; a price below it, or a card with no price, asks a human. Optionally add the paid checkout brief.

recipes.title: Screen every settlement you broker
recipes.result: A facilitator aborts a settle to a blocked seller before the transfer.

limits: TWZRD scores observed wallet and payment behavior. It does not prove a person, company, or agent identity.
A listing card is an observer card, not a merchant attestation. Advertised means a captured page said it; purchase completion and delivery are not verified.
`authorizes_spend` is always false: a check is evidence for your own spend policy, never permission to spend.
Not a wallet. Not a payment network.
